why: Level 0 functions that are word-for-word copies of boot functions (browser/spike/level-copies.py 0: words through the first jr ra, jal/j targets masked; outside 0x1fxxxx also at least 12 words with every call the same distance away as the function itself). normalize-sources.py renames calls to the level copy into calls to the boot function in the browser tree.
level_calls_why: Calls in level-program sources (src/overlays/) that the recovered C names by a boot address, while the level program's jal goes to its own copy, which works on the level's globals. Read from the level program's call sites (browser/spike/ee-disasm.py --level 0): update_cutscene_playback's jal 0x267c08 where the source names update_parts 0x217b88. normalize-sources.py renames these in src/overlays/ only.
why_functions_tsv: Seven entries added by hand (2026-11-24: FUN_L00_0025b868, 00257b50, 00257be8, 00257880, 00251ce8, 0024e838, 002455c0) from config/us/levels/functions.tsv, where each is listed as level 0's copy of the boot function: the words match except call targets (the level's copies of the same callees) and data addresses that differ exactly as build/spike/exe-data-l00.json moves them (checked by rebuilding each lui + offset address). The boot function in level.wasm already uses the moved addresses, so the call is the same. They were missing functions in level.wasm (blend_moby_animation and park_moby_pose are reached by the hero's idle sequence).
